title: Cover large shared evaluation records through storage replay and bounded display
outcome: Cover large shared evaluation records through storage replay and bounded display
acceptance: An existing real evaluation fixture persists an owner-valid shared evaluation larger than 1 MiB within the accepted canonical allowance, then exact-replays it and decodes its receipt.

The same fixture verifies bounded public show/window output and unchanged store footprint on a reachable total or non-source capacity refusal, without a heavy new gate or implementation-mirroring text test.
